thin_template_activation.method: 61 alternating-order process pairs pinned to Linux x86-64 CPU 8, opt=s, ThinLTO, 16 original consumer codegen units, safe ICF and RELR. CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID for creating the control, explicit style, applying the template, walking the visual child tree, and dropping the control. The control theme was already constructed and resolved. One first activation and mean of 12 subsequent activations per control per process. No window, measure/arrange or paint.
